what: Phase 27: the page's IGV image set up to the supervisor's requirements (2 October 2026). Public data only; no patient file was opened and no question was sent to the API.
authorised: 2026-10-03, by the author: 'I give you permission so change igv set up please so screenshots are based on requirements'
requirements: two boxes side by side: where the piece left and where it arrived
only the abnormal reads, coloured by what they say

design.reads: junction_tools.support_with(view=True), the call behind the page's read boxes, chooses them; a temporary BAM of only those reads is what IGV loads
design.colour: each read's YC tag holds the page's colour; IGV: colorBy YC_TAG
design.labels: each read's XG tag holds the page's words; IGV: group TAG XG (joining reads first: their labels start with the junction's number)
design.windows: one goto with every end's window (multi-locus), each centred on its breakpoint; SAM.SHOW_CENTER_LINE true
design.other_settings: SAM.SHOW_COV_TRACK false, SAM.DOWNSAMPLE_READS false, SAM.QUALITY_THRESHOLD 0, SAM.FLAG_ZERO_QUALITY true, SAM.FILTER_SUPPLEMENTARY_ALIGNMENTS false, SAM.SHOW_SOFT_CLIPPED true, SAM.FLAG_CLIPPING true, SAM.CLIPPING_THRESHOLD 10
design.genes: a BED of the local gene table's genes in the windows (whole canonical transcripts) replaces IGV's RefSeq track
design.cleanup: the temporary BAM, gene BED and batch script are deleted when IGV is done; only the PNG is kept
design.not_changed: bam_tools.py (protected; guard exit 0) and its four-image evidence_panel, which /classic, server.py and the benchmarks still use; the /api/igv route
design.assistant: igv_junction_view is not offered to the assistant (ui.HIDDEN_FROM_ASSISTANT): a model gets only an opaque reference and IGV takes a minute

prototype_findings.colorBy_yc: colorBy YC_TAG paints each read in its YC colour (measured: 0 pixels near the blended junction colours with IGV's default colouring, 16,035-21,813 per junction colour on the two YC-coloured IMP01 images)
prototype_findings.opacity: IGV paints reads at about 75% opacity over its (250,250,250) background: #0F766E came out as (74,151,145), #BE185D as (205,81,133)
prototype_findings.wrong_key_caught: the first prototype used SAM.CLIP_FLAG_THRESHOLD, which is not an IGV preference; the jar's preferences.tab names SAM.CLIPPING_THRESHOLD
prototype_findings.intron_only_gene: a gene whose exons all lie outside the window was first written with a 1 bp dummy block; it is now written whole

tests.test_igv_review.py: 45 of 45, exit 0, including one IGV run on IMP01 (IGV 2.17.4, Java 21, DISPLAY=:0)
defects_found_by_it: a position typed by hand failed (KeyError 'reads'): select_reads read scan_end's result under the wrong key; fixed
its own gene check expected 'GENE_A' where the label is 'GENE_A (OMIM)' (the fixture marks it); the check was wrong and was corrected

startup_check: tool contract OK: 11 evidence tools + 4 bridge tools + 4 review tools

walkthrough.command: scripts/interface_walkthrough.py without --cloud (no API question), PRIVTEST = IMP09's files

groups.label: 1. joins the two ends as junction 1 does
1. joins the two ends as junction 1 does (mapping quality below 20, not counted)

split read, other piece elsewhere (mapping quality below 20)

walkthrough.first_try: 29 checks, 2 failed: the walkthrough looked for the tool's result in /api/calls, which lists calls without results; the page itself had drawn the image. The script now reads the call through /api/call?id=, and the second try passed 29 of 29
